findings.evidence: At lines 165–180, each proof specializes `hD` exactly once to its named endpoint; lines 184–187 only use `hD` through `isRight_val_inl hD i`.
findings.fix: Give the first two lemmas local hypotheses `D.IsThrough (Sum.inl i)` / `D.IsThrough (Sum.inr j)`, and generalize `getRight_val_inl` accordingly, or make these implementation helpers private.
findings.issue: `isRight_val_inl`, `isLeft_val_inr`, and `getRight_val_inl` expose the unnecessarily strong assumption `∀ x, D.IsThrough x`, despite depending only on the named endpoint (and, for `getRight_val_inl`, the supplied equality).

summary: Several public endpoint lemmas require the entire diagram to be through although their proofs use only one local arc; the contested `DecidableEq` assumption on the counting theorem is justified by its `Fintype.card` statement.
